rationale: C12 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. It uses the same compact three-part machinery: tax returns made under the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 are opened to inspection by a specified governmental recipient; inspection is conditioned on compliance with Treasury rules embodied in a Treasury decision approved the same date; and the order becomes effective upon filing for publication in the Federal Register. C15 and C22 are also close templates, but C12 most closely matches the child's statutory phrasing and sentence structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: income tax returns made under the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 shall be open to inspection by the Department of Commerce
shared_material.parent_excerpt: any estate or gift tax return made under the Internal Revenue Code of 1939 or the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 shall be open to inspection by any official, body, or commission
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive parallel operative formula, including returns 'made under' the 1954 Code, mandatory availability for inspection, and substitution of the authorized recipient.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Such inspection shall be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Acting Secretary of the Treasury in the Treasury decision I approved by me this date
shared_material.parent_excerpt: such inspection to be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury ... as further amended and made applicable to the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 by the Treasury decision approved by me this date
shared_material.explanation: The same administrative mechanism conditions inspection on Treasury regulations and links the authorization to a contemporaneously approved Treasury decision.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This Executive order shall become effective upon its filing for publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This Executive order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.
shared_material.explanation: Nearly verbatim closing effectiveness clause reinforces the shared drafting structure, though it is routine standing alone.
